summary: Aether Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an At-the-Market (ATM) offering agreement with Rodman & Renshaw LLC, enabling the company to sell up to $10,998,532 of its common stock from time to time at prevailing market prices. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing effective S-3 shelf registration statement, not a special situation. No fixed price, premium, or takeover event is involved. The filing is a standard Item 1.01 disclosure of a material definitive agreement for an at-the-market equity program, with no shareholder vote, activist involvement, or strategic review.
